QUESTION:
In which release did the default of `snapshotter.queue_capacity` change, and what was it before?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0872] config | snapshotter.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `snapshotter.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
queue_capacity = 1000
```

---

# `snapshotter.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | tasks |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `snapshotter.queue_capacity` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
queue_capacity = 10000
```

# `partitioner.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | tasks |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `partitioner.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
queue_capacity = 100
```

response.content: The default changed in PaderQueue 4.0. Before the change, it was `1000` tasks.
